benefits_features.Complimentary Insurance Coverage:
You get two types of insurance coverage with your HDFC Bank Visa Signature Credit Card. They are:
- Accidental Death insurance
- Purchase Protection for Fire and Burglary
benefits_features.Accidental Death Insurance:
- Up to Rs. 50 lakh complimentary coverage
- Insurance kicks in when you make a minimum of 4 transactions of Rs. 1000 or more each using your card in a calendar month
- The transaction cannot be ATM transactions or eCommerce transactions.
benefits_features.Purchase Protection for Fire and Burglar:
- Up to Rs. 50,000 coverage for personal portable equipment.
- Up to Rs. 25,000 coverage for all other assets.
- For the insurance to kick in, the asset purchased needs to be at least Rs. 5,000.
- This coverage is valid only for 180 days from the purchase date.

how_tos.HDFC Bank Visa Signature Credit Card Poi:
You can redeem the reward points you earn on your card for products and vouchers from HDFC’s reward catalogue.
Here’s how you can go about the redemption of the points you have earned:
- Login to your HDFC credit card banking portal.
- If you haven’t registered your credit card, you can find a request option on the next step in the redemption process.
- Select ‘Redemption/Reward Points’, which you can find in the expenditure tab and proceed to choose your credit card.
- You will then be redirected to the online rewards redemption portal.
- Select ‘Redeem Reward Points’, and choose the items you would like to add to your cart.
- Before you check out, make sure that your address and other details are correct. This is extremely important since the product you redeem will be dispatched to the address you provided.
- If the details provided are incorrect, please have your HDFC credit card details and get your details updated. You should proceed with the redemption of your points only once the address details have been updated.
- Once your redemption is complete, you will receive a Redemption Order Number. Note this small number you will need to have for all communication regarding your redemption.
Alternatively, you can also fill in the Rewards Redemption form and mail it to us:
Rewards Helpdesk
HDFC Bank Cards Division
P.O. Box No 16564
Thousand Lights, P.O.
Chennai 600006

How to Apply for the HDFC Bank Visa Sign:
- You can apply for this card on the bank’s website.
- All you have to do is fill in the online application form and provide the required details. You may then receive an email from the bank or an SMS regarding the status of your application.
Alternatively, you can visit your nearest HDFC Bank branch and apply for the credit card there.

What is the validity of the Reward Point: Your Reward Points are valid for three years from the date of their accumulation. This means that if you earn your points in June 2023, they will begin to expire June 2026.
What do I do if I lose my card?: In case you lose your credit card or you see any unauthorized charges made to your card, contact the HDFC Bank call center card immediately and block your card. This way you will not be held liable for any unauthorized transactions made on your card.
What is the interest-free period on this: With the HDFC Bank Visa Signature Credit Card, you are given an interest-free grace period for a period of up to 50 days.
My credit card has an NXP chip. What do: You can still use your credit card even if the merchant you are buying from doesn’t have a chip terminal. In such a case, the merchant will use the magnetic strip on your card and you can proceed with your card.
